newsitem.title: USA: CBOT seeks inflation-index bond, 5-yr note futures.
newsitem.headline: CBOT seeks inflation-index bond, 5-yr note futures.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade said it would ask the Commodity Futures Trading Commission to let it list futures and futures-options based on inflation-indexed 30-year U.S. Treasury bonds and five-year T-notes.
The CBOT board at its regular meeting Wednesday approved sending the new contracts to the CFTC for approval, according to a members' floor bulletin distributed Thursday.

A U.S. Treasury official said earlier this month the Treasury was looking at adding an inflation-indexed five-year note and 30-year bond. The Treasury issued inflation-indexed 10-year notes earlier this year.

The CBOT in late January sent inflation-indexed 10-year T-note futures to the CFTC for approval and said it hoped to have the contracts available for trading this spring. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
